title: Figure 20: rendering of DARPA High Energy Liquid Laser Area Defense System (HELLADS)
description: Computer-generated 3D rendering of a modular laser assembly: rows of stacked grey, blue and yellow modules mounted on a long black base, with a translucent green beam path and red/pink optical housing at one end. Captioned "Figure 20. DARPA's High Energy Liquid Laser Area Defense System (courtesy of P. Saunders, AFRL/RDS, Kirtland AFB, NM)." The surrounding text lists characteristics and technical features of bulk solid-state lasers.
